environment.description: Ktor 1.6.x microservice deployed on a standard Ubuntu 22.04 EC2 instance. The RSA public key is stored at /opt/app/keys/public.pem with standard file permissions (644). The application runs as the 'appuser' user with no MAC policy enforcement. SELinux is in permissive mode (setenforce 0). The JWT public key file is world-readable and accessible by the application process.
